subject: Plan for CVPR
text:
Hi [NAME],

Assuming you and the Common Sense Machines team will be in Nashville for CVPR this year? Would be great to get a coffee & show the team some of the big improvements to the product since we last chatted to see if they might align with what Common Sense Machines is doing on all things computer vision.

We are also hosting an AI/ML happy hour on Friday - you'd be more than welcome to join & share with whoever - let me know if you'd like more info on this & I can share the link.

subject: Congrats on the IPO!
text:
Hi [NAME],

Just heard the news that [COMPANY] is going public - hope you've made
some plans to celebrate this huge milestone. Wanted to reach out since I
saw your case study with SuperAnnotate - thought it might be a good time to
connect.

For context - Twelve Labs, Rhombus Systems and Milestone Systems moved to
us for our ability to curate and annotate video natively on our platform &
to fully leverage our services. We also have a track record working with
advanced key points tracking across care management and sports analytics
use cases with Voxela, Hudl, Pixellot, etc.

Given your experience leading computer vision model development at Hinge
Health - we'd love to exchange perspectives. Let me know if you're up for a
chat Tuesday to Friday next week?
